model_type: strategic allocation planning range — research-only framework, no point return forecast

active_base_core.asset: protected liquidity pending user-specific suitability and product diligence

conditional_process_not_allocation.description: The following are research controls, not recommended weights. Any personalised allocation requires capital needs, risk capacity, account permissions, taxes, product due diligence, current liquidity and an approved risk budget.
conditional_process_not_allocation.core_satellite_logic: Diversified, low-cost public exposure may be a practical substitute for the broad diversification a private fund offers; a small directly researched sleeve is permitted only after the named-item gates below pass.
conditional_process_not_allocation.capital_priority: First remove six to twelve months of essential spending and known near-term commitments from risk capital; do not borrow to close an allocation gap.

cash_measurement.net_cash_yield_formula: If later measured, eligible settled cash receipts net of taxes, fees and recurring costs divided by beginning capital; do not count sale proceeds, unrealised gains, borrowed cash or unverified return of principal as income.
cash_measurement.default_use: Retain in protected liquidity unless a named receiving asset independently passes all gates.
cash_measurement.failure_rule: A return or income shortfall cannot be repaired by leverage, lower credit quality, forced buying or concentration.

total_return_measurement.objective: No expected return, annual floor or probability claim is made.
total_return_measurement.formula: For a later exact strategy, report point-in-time TWRR net of documented fees/taxes/costs and investor MWRR/XIRR separately where external cash flows occur.
total_return_measurement.reinvestment_rule: A cash receipt enters total return once; reinvestment changes later capital and is not a second return entry.
total_return_measurement.failure_rule: No performance claim without reproducible constituent history, trading assumptions, liquidity/capacity treatment, costs/taxes, benchmarks and drawdown analysis.

cash_distribution_policy.actual_measure: No D0 or forward distribution is claimed; historical distributions, if later collected, remain historical observations.

return_evidence.formal_test_requirement: Create a point-in-time, rule-complete replay only after the exact named universe, admission criteria, rebalancing, taxes, settlement and liquidity rules are frozen.
return_evidence.benchmark_requirement: Compare against a suitable protected-liquidity benchmark and a broad-market alternative; disclose drawdown, turnover, capacity and all selection changes.

risk_budget.approval_requirement: Document investor risk capacity, time horizon, emergency reserves, factor concentration, maximum plausible loss, liquidity capacity, account permissions and tax treatment before activating any market exposure.
risk_budget.loss_limit: No loss budget is approved in this generic memo. Sizing must be reverse-engineered from a documented bear case and a feasible, not assumed, exit path.

direct_equities.current_model_treatment: open research universe; no direct equity is currently named, valued, eligible or allocated
required_independent_review: three annual reports plus latest interim disclosures
governance, related-party, pledge and audit review
bear/base/bull valuation with no unsupported multiple expansion
two or three observable KPIs and dated catalyst/invalidation calendar
current liquidity, settlement, account, tax and position-risk test
independent red-team review of the thesis

public_reits.inactive_behavior: Remain in protected liquidity; high historical distribution is not an activation trigger.
required_checks: forward distributable-cash bridge rather than historical-yield extrapolation
project KPI set such as occupancy/WALE/collections, traffic/tariff, utilisation/price as appropriate
debt, refinancing, maintenance capex and expansion/dilution review
current valuation inputs, premium/discount and secondary-market liquidity
governance, related-party, tax, settlement, account and suitability review
portfolio common-risk and approved risk budget
